# cloudflare_field_extractor (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_field_extractor" "example_field_extractor" {
  account_id = "123456"
  extractor = "llm_prompts"
  rules = [{
    fields = [{
      expression = "x"
      name = "x"
    }]
    ref = "x"
    description = "description"
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID.
- `extractor` (String) Extractor type.
- `rules` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Extractor type.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `fields` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--fields))
- `ref` (String)

Optional:

- `description` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--rules--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules.fields`

Required:

- `expression` (String)
- `name` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_field_extractor.example '<account_id>/<extractor>'
```
